title: Standard Clean Architecture Backend Project Layout
description: Language-agnostic production backend folder structure and boundary definitions.

layers.purpose: Protocol handling, HTTP controllers, gRPC, WebSockets, CLI commands
Business use case orchestration, transactions, port invocation
Pure business models, entity invariants, domain events, domain exceptions
Concrete database repositories, cache drivers, external API clients, message brokers

modules.description: Feature domains organized by business capability (Domain-First packaging)

sample_feature_user.user.service: Application layer — use case and business orchestration
sample_feature_user.user.repository: Port abstraction — interface defining database contract
sample_feature_user.user.entity: Core Domain — pure model with zero external dependencies
sample_feature_user.user.test: Co-located behavioral and unit test suite

src.config: Central environment config service with fail-fast boot validation

database.description: Persistence migrations, seeders, and connection pool setup

src.observability: Structured logger, OpenTelemetry tracer, and Prometheus metrics bootstrap
src.main: Application entry point and server bootstrap

tests.integration: Database and external service integration tests

structure.scripts: Migration runners, seed scripts, pre-flight audit tools
